title: Delayed conveyor
brief: Program a conveyor that starts only after a continuous run request has lasted for 5 seconds.
requirements: Initially, the conveyor must be OFF. When Run Request switches ON, begin measuring the time it has been ON.
Keep Conveyor Motor OFF for the first 5 seconds. Once the request has been ON continuously for 5 seconds, turn the motor ON.
Keep the motor running while Run Request remains ON.
If Run Request switches OFF at any point, turn the motor OFF immediately and reset the elapsed time to zero.
If the request returns, a new full 5-second delay is required. Several short requests must not add together.
objective: Understand on-delay timing and reset behaviour.
hints: A TON accumulates time while IN is TRUE and resets on FALSE.
Create a TON instance (e.g. Delay_DB) with PT T#5s, then use Delay_DB.Q as an NO contact in a separate output network.
